Come Join Us! 

 From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects  here .

 Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

 What You'll Get to Do 

 If you thrive on solving complex manufacturing challenges & bridging the gap between design & production, this role offers the chance to make a direct, measurable impact from the shop floor to the sales team. 

 As Product Engineer, you'll be a key technical resource across the organization, processing custom orders, optimizing manufacturing processes, & providing hands-on support to both Manufacturing & Technical Sales teams. You'll draw on your knowledge of product design, materials, fabrication, tooling, & quality standards to help drive the most efficient, cost-effective, high-quality production possible.

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Process & manage custom orders from start to finish

 Create & prepare job packages & required manufacturing documentation

 Support day-to-day production line operations

 Provide technical expertise to Production & PGS (Product Group Sales) teams

 Investigate & resolve operational problems affecting production

 Assist with custom quote preparation

 Support corrective actions, ECNs, & ECRs

 Partner with NPD Engineers on New Product Development projects

 
  What We’re Looking For 

 We're looking for a technically sharp, solutions-oriented engineer who's ready to grow into a subject matter expert for their product group.

 
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering (or equivalent hands-on experience)

 Minimum 3 years of experience in Manufacturing or Production Engineering

 Proficiency with CAD tools

 Working knowledge of machinery, tools, & dies with an eye for finding the right tool for the job to maximize efficiency

 Demonstrated ability to process complex custom orders

 Strong product knowledge with the ability to provide full technical support for a specific product group

 ERP experience a plus

 Position Pay Range 
 $65,000 — $80,000 USD 


 What OBE Offers You 

 
 Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive  benefits  at the lowest cost to the employee

 Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose

 Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses

 Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

 
 OBE Privacy Policy 

 OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.
